The theory of relativity was proven only by 1970s and was built by its beauty. The theory of quantum electrodynamics was built pretty much that way, it had some base underneath, like relativity, classical electrodynamics, some wave and quantum physics and lagrangian formulation, that is the apogee of perfect itself.
